SELECT a.id AS areaId, a.name AS areaName, COUNT(s.id) AS stationCount, SUM(CASE WHEN s.station_status = '已启用' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS enableCount FROM sys_area a LEFT JOIN charging_station s ON a.id = s.area_id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE a.deleted = 0
AND a.parent_id = #{id}
AND a.parent_id = 0
GROUP BY a.id, a.name ORDER BY a.id
